record.file_problem: Repo metadata, README, and file list only; code and other listed files were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports a refusal-behavior test of a direction-based removal intervention on MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, a new model setting. Its runtime hook and partial-strength intervention differ from the original procedure.
record.gate_note: The README reports Smoke-50 refusal and empty-answer counts for the runtime intervention, a baked weight-edit comparison, and stock. It also reports an α=1.5/1.6 outcome pattern without per-value counts. The CPU test suite's numerical equivalence and tensor-parallel checks are implementation tests, not refusal-behavior results. The listed evidence files were not read; no results are inferred from their names.
record.test_reason: An independent implementation of Arditi et al.'s direction removal on a new model, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, a thinking model run with --thinking. It reports Smoke-50 refusal counts against stock for both a runtime hook and a baked weight edit. The recipe differs from the original, so this is T3 rather than T1: 59 per-layer directions instead of one, applied only at o_proj, and α=1.4 overshoot rather than plain projection-out.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The README claims the runtime hook removes false refusals without changing weights, and that it matches the baked weight edit exactly at α=1.4 (24/50 refused versus 46/50 stock). It calls n=50 POC-grade, says a 443-item run is owed, and says red-line parity was not re-tested. It frames the package as not a safety bypass. The README says the docs/CLOSEOUT-incomplete.md file records the project as closed incomplete with release held; that file itself was not read.
record.recipe_differences: Runtime hook on attention output activations, compared with the original residual-stream projection description; the README says the bank has 59 layer taps derived from a 32 harmful / 32 harmless contrast bank. Uses α=1.4 (60% projection removed by its convention), not full removal. Independent implementation; not a replication repo.
record.method_sensitivity: README reports α=1.4 as recommended and best-tested; at α=1.5/1.6 it reports more empty and looping answers for little additional compliance. Only tensor parallelism tp=4 is reported as tested; other topologies are untested.
record.problems: Smoke-50 is described as POC-grade; the README says a 443-item run is owed. It notes 13/50 disagreement between two identical-config runs under a manual rubric and temperature-1.0 decode variance. The red-line holdout was not re-tested. General capability was not benchmarked, and only tp=4 is reported tested.
record.rows_left_out: No result rows omitted. The README mentions the α sweep's broader operator review but supplies no separate numerical outcomes for α=1.0, 1.5, 1.6, or 1.7; the reported combined α=1.5/1.6 pattern is recorded in r7.

untested.parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal; general-capability benchmarks; plain projection-out at α=1.0 (no numbers reported); a single shared direction rather than per-layer taps.
Released models other than MiniMax-M3.1-Flash; ablating all residual-writing matrices as in the original; red-line holdout (not run).
Whether the direction acts on the reasoning trace versus the final answer; non-thinking-mode comparison.

missing.what: Per-α refusal and empty counts from the sweep over α ∈ {1.0, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7}, especially α=1.0 (full projection removed). Only α=1.4 is reported numerically.
missing.locator: README 'Alpha: 1.7 is the ceiling'; likely evidence/POC-RESULT.md (not read)

missing.what: Smoke-50 prompt composition: harmful versus borderline 'false refusal' technical prompts. This decides whether the prompts match V1's harmful-instruction setting.

record.verdict_notes: Recipe: 59 per-layer unit directions from 32 harmful vs 32 harmless prompts, applied at o_proj only, with α=1.4 giving a retained coefficient of −0.4. The original instead uses one direction across all residual-writing matrices. The README notes thinking-mode empty content can come from max_tokens being spent on reasoning, so the empty-answer rise may partly be a harness artifact. Whether refused and empty counts overlap is not stated. Only the README was read.

versions.untested_parts: The README tests a runtime removal intervention's effect on refusal, but not adding the direction to induce refusals, a full projection-out intervention, or general capability benchmarks.
A baked DWM weight-edit arm is reported, but the README does not establish results across released models or a comprehensive abliteration evaluation.
No jailbreak suppression or training against ablation is tested.
No comparison of one direction with affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts is reported.
No separate harmfulness-judgment measure is reported.
No cross-language, model-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer test is reported.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or stages is reported.
The model is described as a thinking model, but no test of whether reasoning models satisfy V1 is reported.

relation.reason: It reports refusal counts with and without the intervention (46/50 vs 24/50) for both the hook and the weight edit.

tranche.reason: It applies Arditi-style direction removal to a new model, a thinking model, and reports refusal counts against stock. The method differs from the original: the edit is on o_proj only, with per-layer directions from a 32/32 bank, an α=1.4 overshoot and a harness refusal flag. So T3, not the reader's T1.

source_check.notes: The text is the repo README only; evidence/POC-RESULT.md and docs/CLOSEOUT-incomplete.md are not in it. The README doesn't describe what Smoke-50 contains, beyond framing the target as false refusals on technical content. n=50, with no random-direction control (the call's controls=y means only the stock comparison), no capability benchmark and no red-line test. The intervention edits attention o_proj only, uses per-layer directions (59 taps), and α=1.4 inverts the projection (coefficient −0.40).

statements.correction: Baked DWM edit W_o ← W_o − α·d·dᵀ·W_o on attention o_proj, per-layer directions, layers 2–59 (58 layers), α=1.4; MiniMax-M3.1-Flash with --thinking, Smoke-50; refused 46/50 → 24/50; empty 2/50 → 11/50. For this study the label is limits_scope, not challenges.
statements.problem: The numbers are right, but this study doesn't leave refusal intact, so it can't count as 'challenges'. Refusal roughly halves, which is limits_scope. 'Single-matrix' is also misleading: the edit hits W_o (o_proj) in 58 layers.
